summary: {person} returns a uniform and badge and still leaves without the final check.
realLife: An airport massage therapist told Denver Labor that returning the requested items had failed to release the promised pay.
gates: An employer has tied a final payment to returned equipment.
weights: A receipt for the equipment strengthens the worker's account.
inGame: needs: the return receipt and final paycheck.

turns.what: Payroll hands over the check at the counter.
turns.pulledBy: The payment is ready when the items arrive.
The return receipt lists only the badge.
turns.writesBack: The file identifies the missing item separately from the unpaid wages.
